summary.headline: Q2 FY27 pre-sales hit a record Rs 3,225 crore, but revenue fell to Rs 292 crore and EBITDA was negative Rs 131 crore.
summary.overview: Embassy Developments reported record Q2 FY27 pre-sales of about Rs 3,225 crore, lifting H1 pre-sales to Rs 4,093 crore, and collections rose 10% QoQ to about Rs 546 crore. Reported financials remained weak: revenue from operations was Rs 292 crore (vs Rs 494 crore a year ago), EBITDA was negative Rs 131 crore and loss after tax was Rs 271 crore, which management attributed to legacy projects and the project completion method. Three launches in the quarter carried a combined GDV of Rs 8,397 crore against a pre-launch estimate of Rs 7,500 crore. CEO Sachin Shah announced he will step down on December 31, 2026, with Aditya Virwani becoming MD and CEO from January 1, 2027.

segments.name: Bangalore
segments.commentary: Embassy Riverine (GDV Rs 3,155 crore) and South Reserve (GDV Rs 1,957 crore) at Embassy Origins; combined sales exceeded Rs 1,800 crore within two weeks, with Riverine at Rs 933 crore and South Reserve at Rs 880 crore. Management cited a 93% EOI-to-booking conversion over those two weeks.

segments.name: Mumbai (MMR)
segments.commentary: Embassy Terazza, Juhu (GDV about Rs 3,285 crore) sold Rs 758 crore shortly after launch, including a single Rs 711 crore residence. Embassy Citadel, Worli, crossed Rs 1,350 crore of sales in under nine months; approvals secured for all 81 floors.

segments.name: Projects nearing completion
segments.commentary: Golf City Savroli received OC for remaining towers in Q2 FY27; OC-received portfolio is over 95% sold by area. Embassy Paradiso is fully sold, with OC slated in FY27. Embassy Edge and East Avenue are about 90% sold, targeting FY28 completion.

segments.name: Park Panvel (legacy Indiabulls)
segments.commentary: 17 towers, about 8 million sq ft, with about Rs 500 crore invested so far and Rs 40 crore monthly burn. First two towers expected to get OC around June 2027. Sold receivables plus inventory about Rs 1,800 crore; management estimates a surplus of Rs 300-400 crore after construction and interest.

guidance_outlook: FY27 guidance reiterated: GDV launches of about Rs 19,400 crore (9 owned projects at Rs 13,300 crore and 2 DM projects at Rs 6,100 crore).
FY27 pre-sales target of Rs 8,000 crore: Rs 6,000 crore from owned projects and Rs 2,000 crore from DM projects.
FY27 collections target of about Rs 3,000 crore; management expects to reach it over the next two quarters (H2 FY27), with about Rs 2,000 crore needed.
Management expects positive operating cash flow by end-March 2027.
Debt expected to start declining around end-Q2 or Q3 FY28 (about this time next year), once collections exceed capex and overheads.
Revenue guidance for next year to be given in Q3 or Q4 FY27 once completion dates are firm; RERA dates have been replaced with completion dates, to be updated every six months.
Launch mix for Q3 and Q4 FY27 to be spread evenly, with Q4 likely to carry a larger share; some launches timed to avoid the mid-December to mid-January market slowdown.
capex_capacity: Owned portfolio: 13 projects with total GDV above Rs 27,422 crore, 55% of area sold (excluding DM projects).
Cumulative sold receivables plus unsold inventory of about Rs 25,536 crore: sold receivables Rs 8,290 crore and unsold inventory Rs 17,246 crore.

Development pipeline beyond FY27 of 20.3 million sq ft with estimated GDV of about Rs 23,470 crore; fully paid land bank of 3,251 acres, including 1,400 acres at Nashik under MIDC resolution and debonding.
Sky Terraces (DM project) targeted for launch in Q4 FY27, delayed by the pending GBA meeting; Sky Terraces sits under the Rs 2,000 crore DM target.
Embassy Citadel, Worli: approvals for all 81 floors; completion in FY33.
Panvel: about 2,000 laborers on site; OC for the first towers from around June 2027, with phased completion after that.
demand_pricing: Pricing: management says Panvel market rate is about Rs 15,000 per sq ft versus its current 12,000-13,000, and it is deliberately pacing sales at Embassy Origins to keep taking prices up.
Eight recent launches (Riverine, South Reserve, Terazza, Verde Phase 2, Greenshore, Eden, Paradiso, Citadel) are over 52% sold by area within six months of launch.
Launches are concentrated in Bangalore, MMR and NCR; Ketan Nanda hired as Business Head for North and Alok Sherry as Head of Business Development for Mumbai.
Management says buyers are mainly end-users in Bangalore; Worli sales were achieved without sample flats or a sales office on site.
Competition and market pricing were not discussed in detail beyond the Panvel and Mumbai commentary.

qa_highlights.question: How will collections reach Rs 3,000 crore in H2, and when will debt fall?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said execution is picking up and it is confident of hitting the Rs 3,000 crore collections guidance over the next two quarters. Debt is expected to decline around this time next year, once collections exceed capex and overheads.

qa_highlights.question: Break down the Rs 11,900 crore of launches planned for Q3 and Q4.
qa_highlights.answer: Launches will be spread quite evenly, with Q4 likely to have a larger share. Some projects with RERA approval may be formally launched only after mid-January, as the market softens in December.

qa_highlights.question: What has been invested in the Indiabulls revival projects, and what is the Panvel timeline and realisation?
qa_highlights.answer: About Rs 500 crore has gone into Panvel, which consumes about Rs 40 crore a month. Panvel has 17 towers and about 8 million sq ft, with OC starting around June 2027. Realisation is about Rs 1,800 crore with upside, and surplus is estimated at Rs 300-400 crore.

qa_highlights.question: Will operating cash flow turn positive?
qa_highlights.answer: Rajesh Kaimal said operating cash flow is expected to turn positive by end-March 2027, as slab-cycle collections from Q3 and Q4 FY26 launches come through.

qa_highlights.question: Why are losses increasing, and when will the balance sheet improve?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said current P&L reflects legacy projects started before the merger. Reverse-merger goodwill is tested for impairment every six months. Cash surplus is about Rs 30,000 crore over the next 3-4 years. Net debt to equity should start improving from next year.

qa_highlights.question: When will the Blackstone Rs 700 crore debt be converted?
qa_highlights.answer: Management is still in discussion with Blackstone but will not convert at current prices, calling it extremely dilutive given the stock trades well below book value.

qa_highlights.question: Can a delay in Sky Terraces hit the Rs 8,000 crore pre-sales target?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said not, citing Juhu over-performance (about Rs 800 crore already) and Rs 25,000-26,000 crore of stock available to sell.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Nashik land monetisation status?
qa_highlights.answer: Early stage: the MIDC issues and land debonding must be resolved first. Data-centre use is being explored because a neighbouring 1,350 MW power plant could supply up to 950 MW.

risks_watch: Collections must reach about Rs 3,000 crore for FY27; H1 was Rs 1,041 crore, so about Rs 2,000 crore is needed in H2, and management expects positive operating cash flow by end-March 2027 (H1 operating cash flow was cited as negative Rs 94 crore).

Losses are persisting: Q2 FY27 EBITDA was negative Rs 131 crore and loss after tax Rs 271 crore; management gave no quantified timeline for when losses end and said revenue guidance will come only in Q3 or Q4 FY27.

Launch execution: Rs 11,900 crore of Q3-Q4 launches, with Q4 weighted and some launches timed after the mid-December to mid-January slowdown; Sky Terraces (Rs 2,000 crore DM target) is delayed by the pending GBA meeting and is targeted for Q4 FY27.
Debt reduction is guided for around end-Q2 or Q3 FY28; net debt to equity was 0.42x at 30 Sep 2026, and the Blackstone Rs 700 crore debt is not to be converted at current prices.
Legal exposure: the NCLT matter (Canara Bank) is listed for November 19, and the KIDB resumption notice is stayed by the High Court; outcomes could affect land and projects.
Panvel execution and realisation: about Rs 500 crore invested, Rs 40 crore monthly burn, first OC around June 2027, and a Rs 300-400 crore surplus estimate depending on pricing.
CEO transition: Sachin Shah steps down on December 31, 2026, and Aditya Virwani becomes MD and CEO from January 1, 2027.
key_quotes: Q2 FY '27 was the strongest quarter in Embassy Developments' history.

We are confident in our ability to deliver our FY '27 guidance across all operating parameters, launching approximately Rs. 19,400 crores of GDV during that year, achieving pre-sales of Rs. 8,000 crores
So, I think we have been consistent with this saying that around the end of Q2, Q3 next year is when really the company will start seeing that.
For us to convert that debt today at this price makes zero sense. It is extremely dilutive given we are trading at significantly under book value as well.
summary.management_tone: Confident on pre-sales, launches and the FY27 targets, with management repeatedly pointing to pre-sales and collections rather than reported P&L. Cautious and evasive on loss trajectory, timing of revenue recognition and debt reduction, where it gave no firm numbers and deferred revenue guidance to Q3 or Q4 FY27.
